note: Groups pages into documents. A page with its own date of service (the DOS stage's Extracted DOS) joins the open document when its From and To are the same, and starts a new one when they differ. A page without a date continues the open document unless the document ended on the previous page: a signature on it, a page that looks like a first page, a page-type change the classifier is sure of (document_end.max_same_type_probability / min_new_type_confidence), or its text stopping in the middle of the page (document_end.page_end_max). A blank or junk page in between always ends the document. Every page of a document takes the first page's DOS as its Final DOS (DOS_DEFAULT_DATE for a stand-alone document of default_final_dos page types). Reloads on change.

pagination.comment: Printed 'Page N of M', read from the header and footer bands (or the key/value page number). Never splits a document: an undated page after 'page N of N' (the last page) starts a new one, and an undated page whose number follows the previous page's (N -> N+1, same M) is a confirmed continue page. Page 1 also confirms a document's first page. max_total is page_arbitration.json's max_document_pages.

bands.comment: Where the header and footer are. With line positions: a line whose top is above head_top is header, one whose bottom is below foot_bottom is footer (fractions of page height). Without: the first head_lines and last foot_lines lines of text, and a quarter of the lines each way for pagination. A line starting below foot_bottom is left out of where the page's text ends.

document_end.comment: When an undated page does NOT continue the previous page's document: (1) the previous page is signed, or its printed number says it was the last ('page N of N'); (4) this page looks like a first page — the keyword model's title for another page type; (2) the page type changes and the classifier is sure — the chance this page is the previous page's type (its confidence when the types agree, one minus it when they differ) is at most max_same_type_probability AND its confidence in the new type is above min_new_type_confidence; (3) the previous page's last body line ends above page_end_max of the page height (needs Final2/Final1 line positions). Consecutive printed page numbers (N -> N+1 of M) override all four.

default_final_dos.comment: A stand-alone document of these pages (every page carrying a name listed here) is not a visit: its Final DOS is DOS_DEFAULT_DATE (dos_canon.json, 2222-02-02) on every page, whatever dates its pages carry. One of these pages inside a visit's document (a progress note with a problem-list page) takes the visit's DOS. Each page's Extracted DOS is untouched. Names are v24 names — canon page types (page_canon_v24.json) or L1 / L2 / L3 — matched without case against every name of the page (axes.names_of).
